notes: This nonfiction picture book explains digestion and flatulence in simple terms. Most key vocabulary already exists in activity_images and aac_extras (body, stomach, burp, food, beans, tummy, laugh, fart, funny). Priority fringe words focus on the digestive process and sensory/social aspects of the topic. The word 'gas' is central to the title and concept. 'Animal' is useful as the book compares human and animal flatulence. Avoid 'laugh' as a fringe word since the core row already covers emotional reactions adequately; 'funny' is retained as it is more concrete and picturable. The book has no named character so a generic child symbol suffices for the hero slot.
